Q5217.reason: The catalog was an invitation to offer, so the purchase order was the offer and Costco's expressly conditional confirmation was an unaccepted counteroffer.

Q6156.reason: The company lacked a similar motive to develop the engineer's testimony on products-liability issues in the wrongful-termination case, so the former-testimony exception does not apply.

Q8413.reason: The Grand Chamber held that Kuwait's state immunity did not violate Article 6, so immunity prevailed over the right of access to a court.
